messages.text: Hya. So I just sent an email to you about an ongoing support issue I have with an outstanding order, as well as a failed/faulty unit still in warrantee. There is some conversation history in relation to this support request in a Wattsapp chat, which you appear to not be using anymore? Let me know if I can you you gain access to this  history so you are fully aware of the problems I have been experiencing.

Handed to the team · Dropship order 2 months old with no date or tracking; warranty unit needs RMA ap

I can't see the WhatsApp chat from here, Laurie, but your email thread is all here, so you don't need to repeat it. If WhatsApp has something the emails don't, paste the key points in this chat.

The BS-2 (Shop····) hasn't shipped and has no tracking. We wrote on September 16 that tracking would follow within a day, and it never came. I'm sorry, two months is far too long.

A fuse that blows on the S1 even with a new power supply points to a board fault. Has it ever been overclocked?

I've sent both to the team. They'll get back to you by email.

The S1 is/was Almost brand new and not overclocked. The initial power supply had issues with unsecured/intermittent contacts on the 240v supply side which I suspect may have something to do with the issue.
Used route to tech
The BS2 was suppose to be a replacement for a Nerdoctax that you failed to deliver from my original order. It was suggested to me because it was in stock, and could be delivered immediately.
Used the order-swap skill

Sarah again, back on the order side. You're right, Laurie. The BS-2 was meant to fix the NerdOctaxe we didn't deliver, and it was offered because it was supposed to ship straight away. Instead you've been waiting since September 16 with nothing to show for it. I'm sorry.

The Hammer Thor P2 (10 TH/s) is on the shelf now and ships within 2 business days. Would you like the team to move your order to that instead? If you say yes, I'll add it to your case. They'll confirm the change and let you know if there's any difference to pay.

The P2 is cheaper than the BS2. it would be a suitable substitute BUT still less Hash Rate than the original NedOctaxe. I am OK with that but WILL NOT pay you any additional money to resolve this issue. Note: there was a credit processed at the time of discussing the BS2 as a substitute. So, please send me a Hammer Thor P2 as a substitute for the  Bitfortun - BS-2, which was a substitute for the NerdOctaxe originally ordered. A bag of lollies/candy or something to make up the $10.00 shortfall would also suffice.
Ran dispute_check.py (order-swap skill)
Handed to the team · Swap tool would invoice $349 on a $0 replacement line; free swap needs a person'

I haven't changed your order yet, Laurie. The BS-2 went on as a $0 replacement, so a swap from my side would come out as the full $349 owed. That's not what you agreed to, so I haven't done it.

I've sent your yes to the team. They have the history: the NerdOctaxe from your May order, the BS-2 in its place, and the difference refunded in September. I've also passed on your request for something to cover the gap. The Thor P2 is on the shelf and ships within 2 business days once the change is made.

The team will email you to confirm.

And in response to Hal. The fuse that blows is the 15amp automotive fuse that is on the S1 unit itself. 
The original power supply required setting
This is a technical answer for Hal, so I'll send it to him.
Used route to tech

(The customer sent this photo without a message.)

Thanks for the serial photo, Laurie. It reads (number hidden). The S1 is on Shop····, the order you gave us by email, so you don't need to look that up.

Hal has finished checking it and passed the S1 on as faulty. The team is now reviewing the return, and once it's approved they'll email you what happens next.

Please don't power the unit again until then. Your Thor P2 request is with the team too.
I can't see anything labelled as a serial number

You've already sent it, Laurie. On the white sticker in your photo, the number printed under the barcode is the serial: (number hidden). That's all we need, so there's nothing more to look for.

The team is reviewing the S1 return and will confirm by email.
Sarah, Are you an AI assistant? Your responses are super fast. amazing if you are human:)

Yes, Laurie, I'm an AI. I'm the team's automated first line of support, and so is Hal. People on the team make the decisions I can't, like your Thor P2 swap and the S1 return. Both are with them now, and they'll confirm by email.

Is there anything else I can help with while you're here?
nope ty. looking forward to FINALLY getting this resolved
